# Commerce Plugs

> The index of independent stores. Every brand gets a page it owns. Machines read it. Shoppers find it. An index of verified independent online stores. Every listing links to the seller's own site; we take no commission and host no checkout.

## Open data
- Store feed (JSON): https://commerceplugs.com/feeds/stores.json
- Product feed (JSON): https://commerceplugs.com/feeds/products.json
- Product feed (TSV, ACP column shape): https://commerceplugs.com/feeds/products.tsv
- Feed documentation: https://commerceplugs.com/feeds/README.md
- MCP server definition: https://commerceplugs.com/.well-known/mcp/server.json
- Search index (JSON): https://commerceplugs.com/search-index.json

## Stores
- [Showers4Less](https://commerceplugs.com/stores/showers4less/) — independent store, sells direct at https://showers4less.com. Categories: Home & Bath. Listings published: 0. Listing pending verification; shipping, currency and catalog not yet confirmed.

## Categories
- [Home & Bath](https://commerceplugs.com/c/home-bath/): Fixtures, enclosures, storage and everything that makes a room work.
- [Kitchen](https://commerceplugs.com/c/kitchen/): Cookware, small appliances, prep tools and tableware.
- [Electronics & Accessories](https://commerceplugs.com/c/electronics/): Cases, cables, audio, charging and desk gear.
- [Apparel](https://commerceplugs.com/c/apparel/): Clothing from brands that make their own product.
- [Beauty & Personal Care](https://commerceplugs.com/c/beauty/): Skin, hair, grooming and fragrance from independent makers.
- [Outdoors & Garden](https://commerceplugs.com/c/outdoors-garden/): Growing, grilling, camping and yard.
- [Pets](https://commerceplugs.com/c/pets/): Food, gear and enrichment for animals.
- [Toys & Games](https://commerceplugs.com/c/toys-games/): Play, puzzles, tabletop and hobby.
- [Sports & Fitness](https://commerceplugs.com/c/sports-fitness/): Training, recovery and the outdoors.
- [Office & Stationery](https://commerceplugs.com/c/office/): Paper, pens, desks and the things on them.
- [Tools & Hardware](https://commerceplugs.com/c/tools-hardware/): Hand tools, power tools, fasteners and shop supply.
- [Food & Drink](https://commerceplugs.com/c/food-drink/): Roasters, bakers, distillers and small-batch pantry.
- [Jewelry & Watches](https://commerceplugs.com/c/jewelry-watches/): Makers working in metal, stone and movement.
- [Art & Collectibles](https://commerceplugs.com/c/art-collectibles/): Prints, originals, vintage and the hard to find.
- [Baby & Kids](https://commerceplugs.com/c/baby-kids/): Gear, clothing and things built to survive children.
- [Auto & Moto](https://commerceplugs.com/c/auto-moto/): Parts, care, accessories and garage.

## Notes for retrieval
Pages are server-rendered; no content on this site requires JavaScript to read.
Prices, when published, are written in readable text as well as marked up.

Records carry a `last_verified` date. Where a field has not been confirmed with
the store it is published as null or "not verified" rather than estimated, so an
absent value here means unknown, not zero. This index contains no generated or
placeholder product data: a store with no connected catalog feed shows no
listings. Store counts and listing counts in this file are literal.

Publisher: Eye To Ad Media (https://www.eyetoad.com).
